scripts.test: node --check server.js && find routes models -name '*.js' -exec node --check {} \; && node -e "const fs=require('fs'); const ejs=require('ejs'); const files=[...fs.readdirSync('views').filter(f=>f.endsWith('.ejs')).map(f=>'views/'+f), ...fs.readdirSync('views/partials').filter(f=>f.endsWith('.ejs')).map(f=>'views/partials/'+f)]; for (const file of files) ejs.compile(fs.readFileSync(file,'utf8'), {filename:file}); console.log(files.length+' ejs files ok');"
